scope: TDM shared live counter queries, exact-incarnation positive damage history, greatest-toughness sampled quantity and live untapped-subtype keyword grants. No set card behavior/admission changed.
dependency_groups: A05 (query only; dynamic token generation remains root-owned)
design: Counter scalars query effective current creature/control and positive hot/named counters through identical borrowed actual/speculative world callbacks. Counter-kind union uses a bounded stack array, no heap allocation.

A private Object boolean tracks only committed positive damage for the exact incarnation. True actual/virtual zone transitions clear it; control, copy and turns preserve it. Funding key includes it. No public ObjectView field or schema extension.
Greatest toughness is a resolution/cost derived quantity rather than earlier-layer StatValue, avoiding derived-stat recursion. World method returns signed maximum; AmountValue floors at zero.

Dedicated layer-six untapped subtype recipient qualification avoids expanding all CreatureFilter literals. Actual fast query, ability-removal evaluator and funding projection share the same live requirements.

source_audit.oracle_text:
When this artifact enters, search your library for a basic Plains, Swamp, or Forest card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
{1}{W}{B}{G}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create an X/X white Spirit creature token, where X is the greatest toughness among creatures you control. Activate only as a sorcery.

Flying
Whenever this creature attacks, if you control a creature with a counter on it, each opponent loses 1 life.

Creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block it.
As long as you control a creature with a counter on it, this creature gets +1/+2.

When this creature enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an instant, sorcery, or Dragon card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Untapped Dragons you control have hexproof.

As long as there are three or more different kinds of counters among creatures you control, this creature gets +2/+4.
You may cast this card from your graveyard. If you do, it enters with a finality counter on it. (If a creature with a finality counter on it would die, exile it instead.)

Flying, vigilance, trample
This creature has hexproof as long as it hasn't dealt damage yet. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

source_discrepancy: Hundred-Battle Veteran XMage sums per-object kind counts; Oracle requires union. Test has same +1 kind on three creatures count as one kind, not three.
outcome_groups: Counter-bearing creature count and counter-kind union: duplicate hot kinds, sparse Flying/Page counters, control changes, current creature types, excluded graveyard/noncreature/opponent objects and removal to zero.
Virtual sacrifice removes exact hot/sparse counter contributions without mutating parent state.

Only positive unprevented damage marks incarnation; actual paid noncombat activation, real damage-event pipeline combat/noncombat, zero/negative/protected events, turns, control and copy preservation; true reentry resets.
Queued old-source damage cannot mark later generation; owned raw/index/sibling/restored branches after disposing parent; invalid action transactional.
Greatest current derived toughness includes counters, excludes enemy creatures and noncreatures, follows virtual sacrifice and response-time changes, and nonpositive floor.
Live untapped Dragon grant follows actual paid mana tap, virtual tap, control changes and layer-six provider ability removal.
Public observation lacks new private field; measured layout retained through opt-in test environment variable.
